messages.subject: Cedar - diligence priorities (internal)
messages.plaintextBody:
Team,

As we get into the data room, the areas I want covered properly: (1) customer concentration and change-of-control clauses - Caldera and Aerelon are the big ones; (2) the aerospace accreditations (AS9100/NADCAP) and export-control licences; (3) the environmental position at the Sheffield site; (4) any live employment issues. Elena - please start the report structure now and flag anything that should be a condition or a specific indemnity.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP

+44 (0)20 7946 0820
